summary: Completed comprehensive testing of EMBZ Designs storefront with Stripe payment integration and Merchize API. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend E2E payment flow successfully creates Stripe checkout session and redirects to hosted checkout. Theme re-design verified. Admin pages functional.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/merchize/health returns ok:true, 921 base products
Backend: GET /api/products returns 4 published demo products
Backend: GET /api/products/{id} returns variants and attributes
Backend: GET /api/categories returns product categories
Backend: POST /api/shipping/quote returns standard ($11.50) and express ($31.00) options for Australia
Backend: POST /api/payments/checkout creates Stripe session, returns checkout_url and session_id, NO order created before payment (correct)
Backend: GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} returns payment_status 'pending' before payment
Backend: GET /api/admin/orders confirms no order exists before payment (correct behavior)
Frontend: Home page hero displays 'FROM THE STRUGGLE WE RISE' with dark neon theme (cyan + rose colors)
Frontend: Shop page loads products correctly
Frontend: Product page loads with 'Add to bag' button working
Frontend: Cart functionality working
Frontend: Checkout page loads with shipping form
Frontend: Shipping form accepts all required fields
Frontend: Country dropdown allows Australia selection
Frontend: Shipping quote calculated correctly for Australia (14-24 days standard, 9-12 days express)
Frontend: 'Pay & place order' button creates Stripe checkout session
Frontend: Successfully redirects to Stripe hosted checkout (checkout.stripe.com)
Frontend: Stripe checkout shows correct amount (US$41.50 = $30 product + $11.50 shipping)
Frontend: No unicode escapes visible in UI text
Frontend: Product cards, buttons (neon cyan), navigation render correctly on dark background
Admin: /admin Orders page renders with 'Merchize connected - 921 blanks' health badge
Admin: Orders table displays correctly (empty state shown)
Admin: /admin Catalog page shows 921 base products from Merchize
Admin: Import dialog available for base products
Admin: /admin Products page shows 4 published store products
Admin: Publish toggle (Live/Off) functional
Admin: Edit and delete buttons available for products
Tracking: /track page loads with order number input and track button

success_percentage.frontend: 100% (payment flow working, theme correct, all pages render)

action_item_for_main_agent:
Payment flow is working correctly up to Stripe checkout. To complete the full E2E test including order creation and cancellation:

1. Manually complete Stripe test payment using card 4242 4242 4242 4242, exp 12/34, CVC 123
2. Verify redirect to /payment/success page
3. Verify order creation and redirect to /order/EMBZ-xxxx
4. Verify order appears in GET /api/admin/orders with merchize_synced:true
5. Cancel the created order via POST /api/admin/orders/{external_number}/cancel to clean up Merchize account

All automated tests passed. The app is ready for manual Stripe payment completion to verify the post-payment flow.
